contract: A durable local broker catalog and subject-scoped revisioned case/event ledger in the existing secret privacy.sqlite3. Owner observations and manual lifecycle steps remain explicitly user_attested. Confirmed removal and reappearance require an internal typed scanner observation and are absent from owner HTTP controls. broker_scan and broker_submit consent gates are enforced independently; API and UI never scan, submit, send, or represent an owner report as provider verification.
remaining_limits: No external broker discovery, scan, opt-out submission, verification request or message send

Confirmed removal requires a future read-only scanner adapter to supply a real VerifiedBrokerObservation; local qualification covers the trusted adapter boundary and ledger semantics, not a live broker result
Broker catalog and case metadata are owner-visible inside the secret local privacy database
No private database export or replication; central secret durability inventory remains root-owned
Dashboard registration, Privacy page composition and metadata-only native tool registration remain root-owned integration hooks
acceptance_coverage: durable broker catalog and one revisioned case per subject and broker
explicit broker_scan and broker_submit consent boundaries
owner observations and legal manual transitions retain user_attested provenance
confirmed removal and reappearance are unreachable through owner HTTP and require a typed internal verifier result
revision conflicts, idempotent request receipts, concurrent retry safety and state-dependent recheck cadence
subject isolation, complete revision/event history, no-store HTTP responses and durable reopen
real HTTP React catalog, case, observation, lifecycle, recheck, history, error and URL-selection workflow
no external sends and no UI or route that promotes owner observation to verified removal
